name: Splakey
look: a lean wet blue monkey with arms flung up, orange palms, a dark headband with a white tuft, an orange face with white goggle-rings, white fur tufts and dark blue shorts
entry: It strikes a pose after every splash, dripping and proud. It practises its moves in rivers and waterfalls for hours, then sleeps for the rest of the day.
how: Evolve Brenkey at level 16. It learns Mach Punch when it evolves.
